_comment: Generated by scripts/update-ability-fire.ts (CR audit tool 1.18); do not edit. An ability is `card-id#n`, n its index in the card's `abilities`. `playouts`: the CR 9.3 ability records each seeded playout format fired (tests/playout/suite.ts checks them). Tests outside the playouts are targeted tests, or sweeps when one test resolves abilities on `sweepCards` cards or more (listed in `sweeps`; they run every card's instructions and check nothing a given ability does). `handBuiltTests` and `sweepTests`: per ability, how many of each resolve it. `neverFired`: per supported card, its abilities no playout fired, with the area it is filed under (tests/ability-fire/abilities.ts) and those two counts. In `summary`, `neverFiredNoTest` have no targeted test and `neverRun` no test of any kind.
